rules.rationale: This simplification rule equates the supplied intToF primitive with the fresh opaque proofIntToF term. Stage 1 explicitly records that equality as conditional trust assumption T1, and prove.sh does not first prove the rule against a module that omits it, so it is an additional trusted domain fact.
This nullary equation defines triangleProgram as the exact MPY Module syntax tree quoted from solution.mpy; it names program data and does not add an execution rule or mathematical fact.
This equation defines invalidTriangle by expanding it to the three side-sum comparisons joined by Boolean disjunction.
This equation defines the semiPerimeter summary as the left-associated sum of the three inputs divided by two.
This equation defines heronProduct structurally from semiPerimeter and the four factors in Heron's product.
This equation defines triangleAreaSpec as the contract summary: minus one for an invalid triangle and otherwise the rounded square root of heronProduct.
